titles: "특대형 부패사건이다" 김정은이 키운 군부 돈줄, 2013년 장성택처럼 제 손으로 잘라낸 김정은

meta._subject_note: 주체 판정 — 이 편은 북한 내부의 절단 서사다(지도부 대 군부·보위성). 양쪽 모두 국가 기관이므로 표면은 둘 다 인공기로 두고, 정체는 복장으로만 가른다(지도부=검은 인민복 / 군부=장군 정모+훈장 / 보위성=검은 제복 정모 / 검열조=붉은 완장). ⛔ 실존 인물의 이름·얼굴은 어떤 장에도 넣지 않는다. ⛔ 한국은 당사자가 아니므로 태극기 구체를 넣지 않는다(반증 레퍼 003이 태극기 대비 구도로 0.2배).
meta.prompt_suffix: Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres. The only legible characters anywhere in the image are the short Korean Hangul labels and numerals explicitly named in the scene description above, rendered crisply and correctly as real Korean letterforms; every other surface that would carry writing shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read, never invented English words and never fake Chinese characters. NO large title or caption overlay text, no watermark. 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 3절 — 김정은이 군부대에 직접 돈벌이를 시켰고 그 돈이 자리값으로 자랐다. 그 돈을 지도부가 도로 빼앗아 가는 순간을 정면 대결로 그렸다. 실존 인물 금지 계열이라 김정은 대신 검은 인민복을 입은 인공기 구체(지도부)로 치환했고, 정체는 복장으로만 갈랐다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Two countryball spheres face off across the upper five-eighths, both wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag — a broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star, thin white and blue stripes above and below — the flag filling each sphere's whole front so it reads instantly. Left: the leadership ball in a black high-collar Mao-style suit, eyes narrowed into hard confident slits with sharply raised brows and a flat closed mouth, both small gloved hands yanking a split plastic shopping bag out of the other ball's arms. Right: the military ball in an oversized general's peaked cap and an olive tunic heavy with medals, eyes blown into huge white circles with pinprick pupils, mouth wide open, three cartoon sweat droplets flying off its surface, shaking motion lines around it, arms still stretched out after the bag. Between them, mid height, a burst of banded US hundred-dollar bundles and Chinese yuan bundles bursting out of the torn bag and fanning upward, a few notes already curling with tiny sparks. Background: a blurred dark Pyongyang street of grey concrete blocks under a smoke-red sky, radial speed lines converging on the torn bag.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 8절 — 대성구역 외화상점 비밀 창고에서 봉지째 담긴 달러·위안 뭉치와 장부에 없는 밀수품이 나왔다. 「자리가 곧 돈」이 얼마나 노골적이었는지를 거대한 계산대 하나로 보여주는 장이다. 군부 구체를 그 위에 능글맞게 앉혀 놓고 검열조 구체는 뒤쪽에 작게 배치했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished shop floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Dead centre in the upper five-eighths stands an enormous chrome-and-glass shop counter rendered with crisp mechanical detail, its top heaped into a mountain of banded US hundred-dollar bundles and Chinese yuan bundles spilling out of ordinary plastic shopping bags, with lacquered luxury watch cases and unlabelled smuggled cartons stacked around them. Perched on top of the pile sits the military ball — a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag, a broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star and thin white and blue stripes above and below — wearing an oversized general's peaked cap and an olive tunic, eyes curved into smug half-moons, mouth pulled into a wide sly grin, one gloved hand riffling a stack of notes at mid height. Small and far behind on the right, a second sphere in a plain dark tunic with a red armband peers in through the doorway with narrowed eyes. Above the counter hangs a glowing shop signboard carrying the word "외화상점" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible; the ledger left open on the counter shows entries printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Background: a blurred dim shop interior with shelving, warm gold key light on the money mountain, floating sparkle accents.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 8절 — 상점 뒤를 봐주던 안전원들이 자기 사무실에서 그대로 붙잡혀 갔고, 「두려워할 대상」이던 조직이 「돈이면 되는 조직」으로 바뀌었다. 추가 리서치의 조직 개편(보위성이라는 이름 자체가 사라짐)을 금 간 현판으로 겹쳤다. 표정 하나로 승부하는 자리라 구체는 하나만 크게 잡았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a plain unlit concrete floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. A single security ball fills the upper five-eighths almost edge to edge — a glossy sphere wrapped in the North Korean flag, a broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star and thin white and blue stripes above and below — wearing a black security officer's peaked cap knocked askew and a dark uniform tunic, both small gloved hands thrown up beside its head at mid height in surrender. thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목의 핵심 「김정은이 키운 군부 돈줄을 제 손으로 잘라냈다」를 그대로 물리화했다 — 자기가 이어 준 돈 파이프를 자기 손의 절단기로 끊고, 반대편에 매달린 군부 구체가 떨어진다. 시킨 것도 자른 것도 같은 쪽이라는 자업자득이 글자 없이 읽힌다.

Across the upper five-eighths runs a thick industrial steel pipeline rendered with crisp mechanical detail, banded dollar and yuan bundles visibly packed inside its cutaway section. Background: blurred grey Pyongyang tower blocks under a hot orange haze, bright rim light on both spheres, radial speed lines from the cut point.

thumbnails.concept_ko: verified-data 3절 — 무역 허가권·통관권을 쥔 자리에 값이 붙었고(사법기관 지도원 자리 10만 위안), 그 인사권을 4년간 팔아먹은 것이 박희철의 죄목이었다. 제목의 「자리값」을 거대한 붉은 인장 하나로 압축해, 자리를 팔던 손이 그 인장에 깔리는 그림으로 만들었다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished desk top — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Background: a blurred dark office wall with a hot red gradient and floating banknotes drifting out of frame, strong specular highlight along the seal.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목 슬롯 4 「제 손으로 잘라낸」의 결과 얼굴. verified-data 1절 — 군 장성급 실명이 노동신문에 그대로 실린 건 2013년 장성택 이후 처음이다. 정모가 벗겨져 날아가는 한 컷으로 「자리에서 떨어졌다」를 글자 없이 말한다. 표정만으로 승부하는 자리라 구체는 하나만 크게 잡았다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a plain unlit concrete ground — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Background: a blurred dark parade ground and grey concrete facade under a smoke-red sky, hard cold rim light on the sphere, radial impact lines converging on the cracks.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 001은 「군중이 김정은을 끌어내리는」 그림이었는데, 우리 편은 「김정은이 자기 사람을 끌어내리는」 그림이다 — 끌어내리는 손의 방향이 정반대다. / [남김] ① 카메라 시점(정면 아이레벨, 주역이 화면 정중앙) — 바꿈 후보 아님 ② 중앙 주역의 얼굴이 화면을 지배하는 구도 ③ 좌우 대칭 붕괴 요소(좌=끌려나가는 쪽, 우=불타는 쪽) ④ 어두운 배경 + 화염 오렌지·딥레드 지배, 상단 5/8 꽉 참 / [바꿈] ① 좌측 주먹 든 성난 군중 → 호송되는 군부 구체 대열(외부 압력 → 내부 균열) ② 우측 불타는 초상화 액자 → 화염 속에 무너지는 무역회사 간판과 흩날리는 달러 ③ 중앙 표정: 식은땀·충혈된 눈 → 땀 하나 없는 냉랭한 정면 응시. 실존 인물 금지 계열이라 중앙 인물은 검은 인민복 인공기 구체로 치환했다.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth dark polished floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Dead centre at eye level, facing the viewer straight on, the leadership ball dominates the upper five-eighths — a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag, a broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star and thin white and blue stripes above and below — in a black high-collar Mao-style suit, its eyes narrowed into cold flat slits with level brows, mouth a hard straight line, no sweat and no tears, lit by a hard orange key from below so it burns bright against the smoke. Left third, smaller and deeper in the frame: a short column of military balls in general's peaked caps being marched away under escort by a sphere in a red armband, heads dropped, caps tilted, past a cracked concrete plaque reading "조직지도부" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible, the smaller notice under it printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Right third: a trading-company signboard collapsing inside a wall of orange flame with a steel filing cabinet burst open beside it, banded dollar and yuan bundles blown loose and burning as they lift through the fire. Background: a blurred dark Pyongyang skyline drowned in deep red and orange with heavy black smoke in the upper corners and radial lines converging on the centre sphere.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 001은 「군중이 김정은을 끌어내리는」 그림이었는데, 우리 편은 「김정은이 자기 사람을 끌어내리는」 그림이다 — 그 결과 자리 자체가 비어 버렸다. / [남김] ① 카메라 시점(정면 아이레벨, 주역이 화면 정중앙) ② 중앙 주역이 화면의 주인인 구도 ③ 좌우 대칭 붕괴 요소 ④ 화염 오렌지·딥레드 지배, 상단 5/8 밀도 / [바꿈] ① 좌측 먹물 뒤집어쓴 동상과 군중 → 주인이 사라진 빈 책상 줄과 쓰러진 명패(verified-data 3절 자리값 구조) ② 불의 출처: 폭동의 불 → 장부·서류가 타는 불(내부 처분) ③ 거리감과 주역 크기: 얼굴 중심 → 거대한 불타는 장부 산을 중앙에 세우고 그 앞에 구체를 배치한 넓은 컷.
thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the frame height is one clean continuous surface — a plain unlit concrete floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Filling the centre of the upper five-eighths, an enormous burning mountain of trade ledgers and steel filing cabinets rendered with crisp mechanical detail, orange flame pouring off it and charred pages lifting into the smoke. Directly in front of it at eye level, facing the viewer, stands the leadership ball — a glossy sphere wrapped edge to edge in the North Korean flag, a broad red band with a white circle bearing a red five-pointed star and thin white and blue stripes above and below — in a black high-collar Mao-style suit, brows pressed hard down into a furrow, eyes locked straight at the viewer, mouth clenched and pushed forward in open anger, one gloved hand tossing another ledger onto the fire at mid height. Left third: two rows of abandoned office desks receding into the smoke, chairs pushed out, brass nameplates knocked flat, drawers hanging open with plastic bags of banknotes spilling from them; the scorched ledger cover on the nearest desk reads "회계장부" in Korean Hangul, crisp and legible, its interior rows printed too small and slightly out of focus to read. Right third, smaller: a military ball in a general's peaked cap held by the arm by a sphere in a red armband, face turned away with its mouth open. Background: blurred grey concrete corridor drowned in deep orange-red, black smoke in the upper corners, sparkle and ember accents.

thumbnails.concept_ko: [모순] 001은 「군중이 김정은을 끌어내리는」 그림이었는데, 우리 편은 「김정은이 자기 사람을 끌어내리는」 그림이다 — 끌어내리고 난 뒤의 얼굴이다. / [남김] ① 카메라 시점(정면 아이레벨, 주역이 화면 정중앙) ② 얼굴이 화면을 지배하는 극단적 클로즈업 ③ 좌우에 붕괴 요소가 계속 남아 있는 배치 ④ 어두운 배경 + 화염 오렌지·딥레드 지배 / [바꿈] ① 좌우 붕괴 요소를 아웃포커스로 밀어 얼굴 비중 최대화 ② 우측 불타는 초상화 → 화염에 녹아 내리는 금고 문 ③ 감정 방향: 압박·불안 → 한쪽 입꼬리만 올라간 서늘한 만족(통쾌함 회수 지점). 주민 반응 「어쨌건 누릴 건 다 누리고 산 것 아니냐」(verified-data 8절)와 같은 온도다.
